<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/v1.0/purchase-orders/ids"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Deletes multiple purchase order records by their unique identifiers in a single batch operation. Use this for efficient bulk removal of purchase orders that are no longer needed.

**Prerequisites**
1. **PurchaseOrderIds** - Use [GET /api/v1.0/purchaseorders](/docs/api/parts/list-purchase-orders) to list purchase orders, extract `Items[].PurchaseOrderId` for each purchase order to delete.

**Workflow Example**
1. List purchase orders: [GET /api/v1.0/purchaseorders](/docs/api/parts/list-purchase-orders) to identify target POs.
2. Extract PurchaseOrderIds for the POs to remove.
3. Delete multiple POs: [DELETE /api/v1.0/purchase-orders/ids](/docs/api/parts/delete-purchase-orders-by-ids) with array of PurchaseOrderIds.
4. Confirm removal: [GET /api/v1.0/purchaseorders](/docs/api/parts/list-purchase-orders) to verify deletion.

**Minimal Required Fields**: Array of PurchaseOrderIds (GUIDs) in request body.
